This week’s highlights: Securitize and Neuberger launch high income tokenized fund; Securitize expands SECZ utility; Carlos Domingo joins Bloomberg; SEC proposes “Regulation Crypto”; Securitize manages $5B onchain; and tokenized stocks in America. American Banker Neuberger Launches First Tokenized High-Income Fund, with Securitize Neuberger Berman, a traditional asset manager founded in 1939, is entering onchain finance with Securitize through the first tokenized high-yield fund, available to eligible institutional and non-U.S. accredited investors across four blockchains. READ MORE The Crypto Times Securitize Links SECZ Shares to Solana’s Onchain Credit Markets Tokenized SECZ is now available on Loopscale’s onchain credit markets on Solana, enabling eligible holders to use their shares as collateral, borrow stablecoins at fixed rates and access liquidity while maintaining their SECZ position. READ MORE Bloomberg We Have A Lot of 'Runway' For Growth: Securitize CEO Co-Founder and CEO Carlos Domingo highlights how a strong capital base provides the company with a multi-year runway for long-term growth and innovation. Watch the full interview to hear his vision for scaling tokenized RWAs to $1T and shaping the future of compliant onchain finance. WATCH NOW CoinDesk U.S. SEC Proposes First Major Crypto Rule in Surprise Announcement The SEC has made its first major step into crypto regulation with a proposed rule designed to clear a path for certain crypto offerings without triggering some securities requirements, advancing efforts to modernize U.S. market infrastructure while preserving investor protections and market integrity. READ MORE Traders Magazine Securitize Manages $5B in Onchain Assets “We were the only tokenization platform with more than $4bn in assets at the end of quarter two, and early in the third quarter we surpassed $5B, becoming the first [company] to reach that milestone,” said Carlos Domingo. READ MORE Vlad Tenev, Robinhood CEO & Co-Founder Tokenized Stocks in America “Tokenization isn’t about putting stocks on a blockchain for the sake of it,” says Vlad Tenev, CEO and Co-Founder of Robinhood, who outlines three immediate advantages of rebuilding ownership infrastructure so assets can move as freely as information online. READ MORE

77822.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Is bitcoin's rally the real turnaround? Bernstein thinks so
77822.body:
Strategy shares hit two-month high as STRC rebounds toward $100 alongside bitcoin | South Korea's Shinhan partners with Solana Foundation, Etherfuse, Orca for tokenized fund issuance | Anchorage CEO says AI agents need bank accounts for 'The Jetsons'-like future | MANTRA freezes all transactions and network following incident |

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Jason Shubnell

Presented by:

JPEG Trading ( https://x.com/jpegtrading?lang=en&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Friday 🎉 Are we so back? *Bitcoin* is flirting with $80,000 after its strongest weekly rally in years, as a historic short squeeze and improving macro sentiment reignite the crypto market.

In today's newsletter, *Bernstein* says *bitcoin's* surge toward $80,000 points to a liquidity-driven momentum shift, *Strategy* shares hit a two-month high with its *bitcoin* back in the black, *Shinhan* partners with the *Solana Foundation* for tokenized fund issuance, and more.

Meanwhile, inside the Oval Office meeting, *President Trump* appeared "bullish" on the *Clarity Act* as he solicited feedback from crypto and finance CEOs, Sarah Wynn reports ( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-08-20-inside-oval-office-meeting-trump-bullish-clarity-act-solicits-feedback-crypto-finance-ceos-412340?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ).

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on *Standard Chartered's year-end bitcoin price prediction* later in the newsletter.

*THE BIG ONE*

*📈 Bitcoin surge toward $80,000 points to liquidity-driven momentum shift as ETF flows rebound: Bernstein*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-08-21-bitcoin-surge-80k-liquidity-driven-momentum-shift-etf-flows-rebound-bernstein-412443?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Bernstein* said *bitcoin's* two-day surge toward $80,000 could mark a broader momentum shift, driven by improving liquidity, rebounding ETF demand, and a friendlier regulatory backdrop.

* Bitcoin hit as high as $79,500 Friday before easing to around $77,000, a rally the analysts tied to the U.S. Treasury's plans to double the size of its longer-dated debt buybacks to $4 billion per operation.
* The analysts said bitcoin historically reacts well to such liquidity expansion, and expect more of it to flow into the asset as a hedge as AI spending increasingly taps debt markets.
* Spot bitcoin ETF flows have also turned, drawing $1.6 billion in net inflows this week, including $606.3 million on Thursday alone, led by *BlackRock's IBIT* , after some $7 billion in outflows over May and June.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Greed is back. A surprise US Treasury buyback expansion torched over $4.5B in shorts and rocketed Bitcoin to $77K — its best week since 2023 — dragging ETFs, corporate treasuries and altcoins along for a euphoric, risk-on ride. 🚀 Bitcoin Tops $77K in Its Best Week Since 2023 Bitcoin surged past $77,000 on Friday — briefly nearing $80,000 — capping a roughly 24% five-day run, its strongest weekly advance since March 2023. The rally ignited Wednesday after the US Treasury said it would at least double its long-dated bond buybacks to $4 billion per operation, driving yields lower and pulling traders back into risk assets. More than $4.5 billion in bearish derivatives positions were liquidated across the week. Read full story 🏦 Bitcoin & Ether ETFs Pull In Record August Inflows US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $608 million on Thursday, lifting weekly inflows above $1.6 billion and pushing August's total to a 2026 high of roughly $2.07 billion. Spot Ether ETFs logged $221 million — their largest single-day intake since October — as institutional demand rushed back alongside the price breakout. More details 💰 Strategy Swings to a $1.4B Bitcoin Profit Michael Saylor's Strategy is back in the black on its 840,447 BTC after the price cleared its roughly $75,385 average cost, flipping a summer paper loss that had topped $13 billion into an unrealized gain of about $1.4 billion. MSTR shares jumped as much as 6–8% to a two-month high, with the firm signaling it plans to resume buying before year-end. Read more 🚨 MANTRA Chain Halts After Exploit as OM Hits Record Low The MANTRA blockchain stopped producing blocks late Thursday and froze all transactions, deposits, withdrawals and bridge operations after an attacker exploited a vulnerability in an upstream software dependency. The native OM token cratered to an all-time low near $0.0041 before partially recovering, with validators staying offline while developers prepare a patched release. See details ⚖️ CFTC Vows to Write Crypto Rules if the CLARITY Act Fails CFTC Chair Michael Selig told industry executives the agency is ready to use its existing authority to draft market-structure rules on its own if Congress can't pass the CLARITY Act this year.
